recommendations.title: Active opportunities need your attention
recommendations.detail: 45 application(s) are mid-process. Keep momentum: confirm timing, prep, and send thank-yous within 24h of each round.

recommendations.title: You have an offer / imminent offer
recommendations.detail: Decide and respond promptly — even a decline should be gracious and fast to protect the relationship. A decline draft is in your Templates tab.

recommendations.title: Lean into Product roles
recommendations.detail: Your strongest segment: 60% reach interview (9/15). This beats your 49% overall — prioritise more of these.
recommendations.action: Search & apply to more Product roles

recommendations.title: Re-engage or archive 28 stalled applications
recommendations.detail: These have sat >21 days with no movement. Send the 're-engage' template to the recruiter, or mark them closed to keep your board honest.

recommendations.title: Reach out to 10 warm contacts
recommendations.detail: Relationships decay. These people already know you — a short check-in keeps you top of mind for current and future roles.
recommendations.action: Open Network tab → send a note

recommendations.title: Indeed is your best channel
recommendations.detail: Roles via Indeed convert at 100% vs 49% overall. Favor postings on this channel.

recommendations.title: Keep your application momentum up
recommendations.detail: Only 3 new applications in the last 7 days. Aim for a steady weekly cadence in your best-converting families to keep the pipeline full.
recommendations.action: Block time to apply this week

recommendations.title: 12 new job leads from alerts · 6 in your strong families
recommendations.detail: From your job-alert emails. Prioritise the ones in families where you already convert well — that's where your effort pays off.

recommendations.title: Recent interview activity
recommendations.detail: Review notes from these rounds and confirm any outstanding next steps.

templates.name: Recruiter intro
templates.when: Cold outreach to a recruiter at a company you like
templates.body:
Hi {Name},

I came across the {Role} opening at {Company} and it lines up closely with my background in {Skill}. I'd love 15 minutes to hear what the team is optimizing for in this hire.

Thanks,
{Your Name}

templates.name: Post-interview thank you
templates.body:
Hi {Name},

Thanks for the conversation today about {Topic}. I'm even more excited about {Company} after hearing how the team thinks about {Challenge}.

Best,
{Your Name}

templates.name: Re-engage stalled application
templates.when: Application sitting >3 weeks with no movement
templates.body:
Hi {Name},

Following up on my application for {Role} — still very interested in {Company}. Happy to share anything that would help move things forward.

Thanks,
{Your Name}

templates.name: Referral ask
templates.when: Warm contact at a target company
templates.body:
Hi {Name},

Hope you're doing well! I'm exploring {Role} at {Company} and noticed you're there. Would you be open to a quick chat about the team, and potentially a referral if it seems like a fit?

Thanks so much,
{Your Name}

templates.name: Offer decline (gracious)
templates.when: Declining an offer while protecting the relationship
templates.body:
Hi {Name},

Thank you so much for the offer and for the time the team invested. After careful thought I've decided to go in a different direction, but I was genuinely impressed by {Company} and hope our paths cross again.

Warmly,
{Your Name}
